credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/mint.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. BRACED: a stout square-stemmed sprig on two crinkled leaf feet, the lead leaf raised as a shield, a cupped tuft of young leaves for a head, a runner creeping off behind. Gesture: the tuft folds shut, then springs open like a fan with a puff of frost, holds, settles. One hue, so the dark slot is a cold hue-shifted teal (sunk veins, the stem's shade face); white is hoarfrost on the puckers and rims. Sport: 'Chocolate' mint.
